newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Dec 96 jobless falls to 13.6 pct y/y-finmin.
newsitem.headline: Polish Dec 96 jobless falls to 13.6 pct y/y-finmin.

text.p: Poland's registered unemployment rose to 13.6 percent of the workforce in December from 13.3 percent in November, but was lower than 14.9 percent a year ago, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said on Wednesday.
"In December, some 2.35 million people had no jobs, or 13.6 percent of the workforce," Kolodko told parliament during the second reading of the 1997 budget draft.
The Central Statistical Office (GUS) is due to release the official December unemployment figure on Thursday.
Poland's unemployment usually increases at the end of the year because many seasonal jobs in agriculture and construction end. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
